title: Map 10: Jerusalem in the Time of Jesus
note: City plan; landmarks that exist today (Garden Tomb, Holy Sepulchre at 'Golgotha (traditional)', Gethsemane, Pool of Bethesda, Gihon Spring, Pool of Siloam, Tower of Phasael = Tower of David citadel). Marked at the centre of each symbol; the Phasael diamond and the citadel coordinates are not exactly the same point. The plan is schematic: landmarks are 30-80 m from where a true-scale fit puts them, with no common shift, so expect about 0.1 km error.
